title: Deep Survey BFS Claims
description: Each line in claims.jsonl is one object matching this schema.

claim_id.description: Stable ID like C001, C012, C0123.

kind.description: kind=synthesis is reserved for cross-paper aggregations (e.g., institutional concentration, year-over-year route shifts) computed from other claims; it requires depends_on and does NOT require a verbatim quote.

paper_id.description: Resolves to a row in paper_index.md. Use '*' for kind=synthesis claims that span multiple papers (e.g., institutional distribution).

section.description: Section, table, or figure reference within the paper. Examples: 'Abstract', '§4.3', 'Table 2', 'Figure 5'. For kind=synthesis, use a free-text label like 'Cross-paper institution analysis'.

quote.description: Verbatim quote from the paper, OR an explicit table/figure reference description. Empty quote requires explicit table_ref or figure_ref. For kind=synthesis, this field carries the computed conclusion in prose.

table_ref.description: Specific table cell reference, e.g., 'Table 4, row LaBraM-base, column TUEG accuracy'.

figure_ref.description: Specific figure reference, e.g., 'Figure 5b, line REVE-large'.

superseded_by.description: If status='superseded', the claim_id that supersedes this one.

depends_on.description: Other claim_ids this claim depends on. Used by the validator's confidence-propagation rule: if any depends_on target lifts from medium to high (e.g., a hardware spec is later confirmed), the dependent claim's confidence ceiling can be re-evaluated. Example: a runtime claim with confidence=medium because hardware was unspecified may depend_on a later hardware-confirmation claim, which when present allows promoting the runtime claim to high.

source_tier.description: Provenance of the quote/finding, recorded honestly so abstraction level is auditable: 'full-text' = read from the paper PDF/HTML; 'abstract' = from the abstract only; 'metadata' = from title/venue/index records; 'secondary' = from a review, blog, or third-party summary. Surveys built from search results (not full PDFs) should set 'abstract'/'metadata' and pair with confidence<=medium. The synthesis prose must carry a one-line provenance note stating the dominant source_tier (see templates/survey-skeleton.md).
